Prep
10 min
Cook
10-15 min
Serves
4
Makes
2 bowls
Cuisine
Andalusian & <Italian>

A weeknight recipe from Málaga.

Tip

Use fresh basil.

Ingredients#

For the sauce#

  • 2 cups tomatoes
  • 1 tsp salt

Steps#

  1. Boil water for 10 minutes.
  2. Toss with the sauce.

Warning

When do you add the basil?

  1. Before boiling
  2. At the end

Answer: B. At the end

Notes#

Keeps 3 days.
